Definition: Jamin, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jamin = "right hand"; 1) the 2nd son of Simeon; founder of the family of Jaminites; 2) a Judaite, the 2nd son of Ram the Jerahmeelite; 3) a Levite who helped Ezra interpret the Law
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
